# The bill, attached to the CAD payment that overpays it, declaring the
# 100.00 USD it leaves as a claim on the vendor. The payable mirror of
# `fx_usd_invoice_overpaid_from_the_cad_bank.txt`.
#
# The split the retarget divides is the +200.00 USD payable side, 274.00 being
# its CAD value, so `amount: 200` and `prepayment: 100` are both USD.
#
# The 100.00 USD paying the bill is converted at the payment's 1.37, against
# the 1.40 the bill was posted at, so it consumes the bill's cost basis and
# realizes 3.00 CAD, which `Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD` takes (Q-054).
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:FX Gain
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

bill "BILL-USD-RETARGET"
	vendor_id: "V-US"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Expenses:Consulting"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
		memo: "Bill BILL-USD-RETARGET"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-25
		amount: 200
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank"
		txn_guid: "TXN_GUID"
		prepayment: 100
		memo: "Payment for BILL-USD-RETARGET"
		Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
